versions.changelog:
Major update: Migrated to a minimal Node-based CLI, focusing on simctl/idb automation and streamlined command set.

- Replaced 21+ mixed Python/bash scripts with a single `ios-sim.mjs` Node CLI.
- Simplified functionality: core iOS Simulator device, app, and UI automation (create/boot/install/launch/tap/screenshot/etc).
- Default output is now single-line JSON for token efficiency; pretty output and summaries are opt-in.
- Added structured troubleshooting documentation.
- All advanced/specialized scripts removed; only essential simctl/idb workflows remain.

- Initial release of ios-simulator-skill with 21 production-ready scripts for iOS app testing, building, and automation
- Scripts cover build automation, semantic UI navigation, accessibility testing, simulator lifecycle management, permissions, and device operations
- Optimized script outputs for AI agent consumption with minimal tokens and optional JSON formatting
- All scripts support environment autodetection, batch operations, and human or machine-readable outputs
- Comprehensive documentation and usage patterns included for quick onboarding
